name: mutagen-panel
description: A local web dashboard for Mutagen: create, pause, flush and monitor sync sessions in the browser; add servers with a password once and use key login afterwards; groups, drag & drop, remote directory browser. 本机运行的 Mutagen 网页管理面板。
author: Arra

scripts.test: tsx src/mutagen-test.ts && tsx src/config-test.ts && tsx src/servers-test.ts && tsx src/pull-test.ts && tsx src/remote-test.ts && tsx src/files-test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run verify && npm run build
